text: Yes — an autoimmune disease-associated IL2RA haplotype linked to Type 1 Diabetes correlates with diminished IL-2 responsiveness (reduced STAT5a phosphorylation) in CD4+ T cells, lower FOXP3 expression in Tregs, and reduced suppressive function, while Il2 haplodeficiency similarly reduces CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cell function in mice, supporting the claim.
